verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows that Amplitude's own developer-facing tools (the Wizard CLI, MCP server or SDK tooling) let the user turn off telemetry or usage tracking. The SDK 'consent model' and Session Replay's 'honor consent' controls govern what the customer's end users have captured, not the user opting out of Amplitude's own tracking. That is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.
